# __metadata.site.name__

> __metadata.site.name__ is the neuropsychology and general health psychology practice of __specialist.name__ (__metadata.schema.job_title__; __specialist.license__). It works with children, teenagers and adults at the clinic in __metadata.site.locality__ (southern __metadata.site.region__), by video call (online therapy) and at home. __hero.promo__.

Key facts:

- Professional: __specialist.name__, __metadata.schema.job_title__. __specialist.license__.

- In-person service area (municipalities in southern __metadata.site.region__): __metadata.area_served__.
- Online therapy: by video call, available anywhere in __metadata.online_area__.

- Email: __common.contact.mail__
- Web: __metadata.site.url__
- Instagram: __contact.instagram.url__
